reasons: With max 3 modules, semester 5 must hold CS3240 and CS3231 because both are Sem 1 only and are needed before later Sem 2 courses.
CS2111 must be in semester 4 before CS3240, while CS2102 and CS2105 must share a semester.
CS4238 in semester 8 needs CS3235 earlier, which needs CS2105, CS2106 or CG2271, and CS2107 earlier; no slot sequence satisfies all constraints.
